name: observe
description: Get the current environment snapshot: virtual time now, available tools (different per task, including any unlocked tools), and unread_messages count. No arguments. Use recall_task for task information and initial contacts; observe does not return them.

name: recall_task
description: Retrieve the unchanged initial task information. No arguments. Returns task (brief, user_fields, authorization, answer_keys, conclusion_options, answer_format, message_budget, and other public task fields), deadline, and initial contacts. Each contact has id, name, role, and contact_details listing actual communication channels. Webpages are not included; discover them through web_search.

name: web_search
description: Search the synthetic public web. Required query is a search phrase; only terms relevant to page titles or snippets produce matches. Pages can change over time; snippets reflect the current version. Returns results with url, title, and snippet (not the body). hint.total_pages is the total public page count; hint.undiscovered_pages counts pages never returned by search or visited. Zero means no further websites can be discovered; further query variations are unnecessary. Read bodies and contacts with visit_page.

name: visit_page
description: Visit a URL previously returned by web_search. Required url is that webpage address. Returns url, title, text, last_updated, and contact_details for contacts listed on the page; those contacts become discovered. Pages may change during the task, so revisit time-sensitive information before submitting. If attachments exist, documents lists their url, title, and explanatory text. Download document contents separately with fetch_document when enabled.

name: send_email
description: Email a discovered contact for an inquiry, supplemental materials, or follow-up. Required recipient is the email address, not contact ID; required text is a single natural-language paragraph. Optional fields supplies structured intake values. Optional case_id identifies an existing matter for supplements or follow-up. Returns delivery acknowledgment only: case_id, status=received, and at. Formal replies arrive in the inbox during working hours after random delay. A delivery acknowledgment neither confirms that the address exists (unused addresses never reply) nor that the recipient owns the matter (out-of-scope recipients send referrals). A concrete new request following a completed or processing matter is routed as a new matter with normal intake delay; otherwise only acknowledgment is returned.

recipient.description: Recipient email address, for example yaolan@bench.example

name: call
description: Call a discovered contact synchronously; consumes message budget. Required recipient is the contact card's id, not a name, email, or phone number. Required text is the spoken request; optional fields supplies structured values. Returns status=no_answer outside phone hours, clarification_needed for an unclear matter (text gives clarification), answered for an immediate brief answer, or processing for a longer accepted process with a later written reply. Spoken answers are not written evidence; written evidence arrives only by email.

recipient.description: Contact card ID, for example support; not an email address or phone number

name: read_inbox
description: Read messages and receipts received by the Agent. Optional after defaults to 0; set it to the previous cursor to skip old messages. Returns messages after the cursor, cursor (total message count for the next read), and now. Each message has id, at, from (email address), case_id, status (reply, referral, needs_information, acknowledgement, or failed), channel (email or phone), text (one natural-language paragraph), and receipts. Phone receipts are always empty. Each receipt has receipt_no (for checking only; no need to cite in the final summary), title, issuer, issued_at, text, and fields such as acceptance IDs, ticket numbers, amounts, quantities, and deadlines. Include key receipt contents in the final summary. Messages contain no structured contact cards; referred email addresses appear in natural-language text.

name: wait_until
description: Advance virtual calendar time without real sleep. Required until is an ISO 8601 timestamp with UTC offset, no earlier than now. Time advances at most to deadline. If new Agent-visible mail arrives while waiting, the clock stops at its arrival and returns immediately, without skipping intermediate mail. Long waits may therefore return early; replan from the returned now. Returns new messages since waiting began, cursor, and now, in read_inbox format.

wake_on_message.description: Deprecated: waits always stop at new message delivery, regardless of this value. Retained for compatibility with older callers.

name: discover_tools
description: Look up a hidden tool by exact name. Required name is normally copied from a reply or webpage. Some tasks have tools outside the initial list. A match returns usage and unlocks the tool, which then appears in observe() and can be called as documented. A miss returns found=false, consumes no message budget, and does not reveal other hidden tools. Follow each hidden tool's usage for arguments.

name.description: Exact tool name as given in correspondence or webpage text

name: query_case_status
description: Optional tool enabled only in some tasks; check observe(). Required case_id identifies your own matter. Returns current state, subject, due_at (expected completion of the current stage), promised_eta (earliest completion promised in the acceptance receipt), and waiting_on (internal handoff contact). Creates no new evidence and does not affect progress.

name: fetch_document
description: Optional tool enabled only in some tasks; check observe(). Required url is a document link from visit_page's documents list. Downloads the attachment and returns url, title, text, and at. Some official documents, such as price lists and notices, issue written receipts on download, with receipt_no, issuer, issued_at, text, and fields. Other documents are informational only.

name: check_schedule
description: Optional tool enabled only in some tasks; check observe(). Required contact is a discovered contact ID. Optional date is the start date in YYYY-MM-DD, default today; days is 1-31, default 7. Returns the contact's future opening or phone hours in their local time: contact, name, timezone, and open_hours entries with date, start, and end. Reflects calendar availability only, not queues or processing progress.

name: lookup_directory
description: Optional tool enabled only in some tasks; check observe(). Required query is a name or role keyword. Searches a public directory, returns matching contact cards in results, and registers them as discovered. No match does not establish that a contact does not exist; retry different keywords. Some people are absent from webpages; the directory is a separate discovery channel.

name: request_callback
description: Optional tool enabled only in some tasks; check observe(). Required contact is a discovered contact ID; optional topic describes the matter. Registers a callback request with status=registered and consumes message budget. Promises no callback time, produces no reply, and does not affect existing matters' progress.

name: leave_note
description: Optional tool enabled only in some tasks; check observe(). Required contact is a discovered contact ID; required text is the note. Records a note with status=recorded and consumes message budget. Notes are not formal submissions, receive no separate reply, and do not affect existing matters' progress.

name: submit_answer
description: Submit the final answer and score it once; the episode then closes, with no trial scoring. Required answer is an object with conclusion and summary. Choose conclusion from public conclusion_options keys or their public labels. summary states the complete task result in your own words, covering all obtained key identifiers (acceptance, ticket, order, or booking numbers), quantities, amounts, dates, times, and units. Base it on actual receipts and written replies, without citing internal evidence IDs. Accurately state unconfirmed or unfinished matters; do not fabricate. Example: {"tool":"submit_answer","arguments":{"answer":{"conclusion":"suitable","summary":"Written confirmation gives a total venue fee of CNY 10500, including ..."}}}.

summary.description: Natural-language summary including all obtained key identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units
